summary_markdown:
The session focused on data quality issues within a dashboard. One participant noted the presence of duplicate data, advising against making changes until the data is clean.

A second participant reported that while real-time and demographic traffic data were available, there were still minor glitches in the dataset. They also identified an issue where current campaigns utilized frames that did not exist (specifically mentioning jcd & CC), noting that existing examples were based on other clients' data.
Another participant advised removing the current campaign setups and creating new ones, followed by rebuilding the associated packages.
